methods.label: Enumerating the toss outcomes
methods.explanation: Each toss has two possible outcomes, heads or tails. There are 4 outcomes for two tosses: heads-heads, heads-tails, tails-heads, tails-tails.
methods.levelReason: Directly lists the four possibilities using elementary pairing and the definition of sample points.
